title: oritrophium hieracioides
intro: Oritrophium hieracioides, commonly known as Hieracium, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as a diuretic. The therapeutic actions of Oritrophium hieracioides include its ability to stimulate liver function, enhance immune system response, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
